name: io.github.tellagen/mcp-server
description: Investigate incidents with your own AI client and post findings and timelines to Tellagen.

environmentVariables.description: Optional. A Tellagen API key (starts with tllg_) that wins over a browser sign-in. Without it, sign in with npx @tellagen/mcp-server login or the tellagen_sign_in tool.
environmentVariables.name: TELLAGEN_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Optional. The Tellagen API base URL (e.g., https://mycompany.api.tellagen.com). Without it, the browser sign-in finds the workspace.
environmentVariables.name: TELLAGEN_API_URL

environmentVariables.description: Toolsets to list, comma-separated: diagnosis, incidents, timeline, postmortem, settings, or all. Defaults to diagnosis,incidents.
environmentVariables.name: TELLAGEN_TOOLSETS

environmentVariables.description: Optional opaque local profile identifier used to scope diagnostic observations across MCP client profiles.
environmentVariables.name: TELLAGEN_MCP_PROFILE_ID
